about.title: About the Tour
about.subtitle: Waterfalls, Cable Car & Old Town
about.intro: Join us on an unforgettable journey through Antalya, one of Turkey's premier holiday destinations, boasting stunning coves, pristine beaches, and a vibrant city center. Our full-day Antalya City Tour is designed to showcase the must-see attractions of this enchanting city.
about.karpuz-desc: Witness the awe-inspiring power of nature as we visit one of Anatolia's most magnificent waterfalls, cascading 45 meters into the sea. Capture the beauty of countless rainbows amidst the breathtaking landscape. This unique waterfall creates a spectacular scene where fresh water meets the Mediterranean Sea.
about.duden-desc: Explore this natural wonder, visited by over 100,000 people annually. Immerse yourself in the serene surroundings, take leisurely walks in the surrounding park, and capture memorable moments with your camera. The lush greenery and peaceful atmosphere make this a perfect spot for relaxation and photography.
about.tun-desc: Enjoy unparalleled views of Antalya from the summit of Tunektepe Mountain. Glide up 800 meters above sea level for panoramic vistas of Konyaaltı Beach, Sıcan Island, and the picturesque harbor. The cable car ride itself is an unforgettable experience, offering breathtaking views at every moment.
about.note: Please Note: Tunektepe Cable Car is closed on Mondays, and a scenic boat tour will be arranged as an alternative, allowing you to explore Antalya's stunning coastline from the water.
about.oldtown-desc: Step back in time as we wander through the historic streets of Kaleici, also known as Old Town. Marvel at architectural wonders spanning centuries, from the Bergama Kingdom to the Ottoman Empire. Discover charming narrow streets, historic mansions, boutique hotels, and traditional shops. The ancient harbor and Hadrian's Gate are among the highlights of this fascinating district.

aspendos.subtitle: Discover Antalya's Ancient Treasures
aspendos.description: Explore three magnificent ancient cities and witness the beauty of Manavgat Waterfall on this comprehensive tour.

about.title: About the Tour
about.subtitle: Perge, Aspendos, Side & Manavgat Waterfall
about.intro: With the Perge, Aspendos, Side & Manavgat Waterfall tour, you can discover the beauty of Antalya Nature. By joining this cultural excursion, you can explore the glorious city with marble doors Perge, Aspendos with infinite acoustic and great harmony of old and new, and the holiday town of Side.
about.perge-desc: Our Antalya cultural tour starts with Perge. The Mediterranean region is the land of beauties surrounded by Cilicia in the East, Pisidia in the North, and Lycia in the West. Visit the Ruins of Perge, one of the two port cities now located inland from the Mediterranean coast and among the best-preserved ancient cities so far.
about.perge-desc2: While walking around the colonnaded street in Perge, where important archaeological excavations were made, visualize social life in the Roman period by walking through the agora, bath, waterways, and theater. Discover yourself on the stairs of St. Paul and Barnabas in Anatolia.
about.aspendos-desc: While you are at the top of the Aspendos Theater, you will witness a fantastic scene. Moreover, when entered through the main gate, you'll hear the whispers of Architect Zenon. And surprise! The great method of transporting water streams to the Aspendos acropolis, which was built on a 50-60 meter high hill by the technical possibilities of almost 2000 years ago.
about.side-desc: Our last ancient city stop will be Side. Compare the ancient and modern life hidden in each other in the modern port town of Side, established within the ancient Roman walls. See the Apollo Temple and spectacular beach of Side while witnessing what we can bring from the past to the present.
about.manavgat-desc: At the end of the day, the magnificent view of Manavgat Waterfall will be waiting for you to rest and cool off. Experience the refreshing mist and natural beauty of this stunning waterfall.

demre.subtitle: Ancient Lycian Cities & Sunken City Boat Tour
demre.description: Explore Myra rock tombs, visit Saint Nicholas Church, and cruise the stunning Kekova sunken city.

gallery.title: Experience Gallery

about.title: About the Tour
about.subtitle: Myra, Saint Nicholas Church & Kekova Sunken City
about.intro: Experience the enchanting Demre, Myra, and Kekova Tour, where history, culture, and the serene blue surroundings will captivate you. Delve into the fascinating world of archaeology as you witness the most magnificent examples of original Lycian rock tombs. Follow in the footsteps of Santa Claus himself in Myra, and explore the unique beauty of Kekova, shaped by an ancient earthquake disaster.
about.eagle-desc: Begin your journey with a scenic drive from Antalya to Kekova, passing through breathtaking landscapes, lagoons, and lakes. Pause for a coffee break at the majestic Falcon Hill, offering panoramic views of the stunning Mediterranean coastline and surrounding mountains.
about.myra-desc: Explore the ancient capital of the Lycian Civilization, Myra. Marvel at the embossed rock tombs carved into the cliffs, wander through the well-preserved ancient theater, and admire the intricate carvings at the river necropolis as our experienced guides unveil the mysteries of this ancient city. The rock-cut tombs are among the most impressive examples of Lycian architecture in Turkey.
about.nicholas: Church of Saint Nicholas - Santa Claus' Home
about.nicholas-desc: Pay homage to the legendary figure of Santa Claus at the Church of Saint Nicholas, where the benevolent spirit of charity and love still resonates. Discover the history and legacy of Saint Nicholas as you stroll through the magnificent church. Learn about how this 4th-century bishop became the inspiration for the modern Santa Claus legend.
about.kekova: Kekova & Sunken City - Ancient Underwater Ruins
about.kekova-desc: Cruise along the captivating Kekova region, dotted with islands, bays, and ancient ruins. Witness the surreal beauty of the sunken city, submerged by geological movements and earthquakes. Marvel at Teimiussa and Simena, the main Lycian settlements in the area, during a memorable two-hour boat tour. The crystal-clear waters allow you to see the ancient ruins beneath the surface.
about.swimming: 🏊 Swimming Break: Swimming breaks will be provided during the boat trip in the pristine Mediterranean waters. Don't forget to bring your swimwear and enjoy the refreshing turquoise sea!

about.intro: The tour starts with your pick up from your hotel in Selcuk at 09:00 am. After all the participants meet up, the discovery of Ephesus begins with the House of Virgin Mary.
about.virgin: House of Virgin Mary - Sacred Pilgrimage Site
about.virgin-desc: The place where Mary may have spent her last days. This place was officially declared a shrine of the Roman Catholic Church in 1986, and since then it has become a popular place of pilgrimage. Pope Paul VI visited the shrine in 1967.
about.ephesus-desc: An exceptional testimony to the cultural traditions of the Hellenistic, Roman Imperial and early Christian periods. It is an important site for Christianity, being one of the seven Churches of Revelation. Apostle Paul probably spent two and a half years in Ephesus during his third missionary journey. In two hours, you will be exploring the city by walking on the marble streets, accompanied by our English speaking tour guide.

about.title: About the Tour
about.subtitle: Pamukkale Tour from Antalya
about.intro1: Embark on an unforgettable journey from Antalya to Pamukkale and Hierapolis. Led by professional guides, this excursion promises an epic exploration of two of Turkey's most iconic destinations, both listed on the UNESCO World Heritage list. Experience the thermal waters, walk through ancient history, and witness one of Turkey's most breathtaking natural wonders.
about.departure-desc: Your adventure begins with an early morning pick-up from your hotel in Antalya, where you'll meet our experienced guide. We'll officially kick off our journey towards Pamukkale, ready to uncover the wonders that await us on this remarkable daily excursion.
about.pamukkale-desc: Our first stop takes us to Pamukkale, renowned for its stunning natural beauty and terraces filled with thermal water. As we explore the majestic Pamukkale mountain and its terraces, marvel at the rock formations adorned with cascading pools of carbonate minerals. These travertines, formed through chemical reactions and mineral precipitation, offer a unique opportunity for relaxation and bathing.
about.thermal-desc: Immerse yourself in the thermal region of Pamukkale, home to numerous hot water sources. The temperatures of these springs range from 35 to 100 degrees Celsius, offering therapeutic benefits for ailments such as rheumatism. Pamukkale's natural springs have been sought after for their medicinal properties since ancient times, drawing thousands of visitors seeking both health benefits and the area's breathtaking natural beauty.
about.hierapolis-desc: Following our exploration of Pamukkale, we'll journey to the ancient city of Hierapolis. Once famed for its baths, this historical civilization has welcomed countless visitors seeking rejuvenation. Explore authentic historical sites such as the Roman Amphitheater, St. Philippe Basilica, Necropolis, and the renowned Cleopatra Pool.
about.conclusion: After indulging in lunch at a nearby restaurant, we'll head back to Antalya and return you to your resorts, concluding this memorable day trip.

day1.title: DAY 01: Flight to Kayseri or Nevsehir - North Cappadocia Tour
day1.content: 04:00am, pick up from hotel and transfer to Istanbul airport for flight to Nevsehir at 06:45am. 08:00am, Arrival & transfer to Cappadocia. Our first stop will be Uchisar, where you'll have the opportunity to take pictures of "The Castle" and explore the area around it (from the outside). Next, we'll drive to Cavusin (Rose Valley), renowned for its stunning red rock formations. Following this, we'll visit the Valley of Fairy Chimneys, Pasabagi, and Zelve Open Air Museum. After lunch visit Devrent Valley and Three Beauties Valley, which are among the most important sights of North Cappadocia. Afterward, we'll continue to the ancient towns of Urgup and Avanos, famous for their red clay pottery. Here, you'll have the chance to try your hand at pottery-making. As an optional activity, we can also visit a Turkish rug and carpet-making factory. Overnight in Cappadocia.

day2.title: DAY 02: South Cappadocia Tour - Flight to Izmir
day2.content: After breakfast, Pick-up from the hotel will be at 9:30-10:00 AM. The tour begins with a visit to Ortahisar, where you'll have a great photo opportunity to capture the iconic Ortahisar Rock Castle. Next, we head to Mustafapasa, a former Greek village once known as Sinasos. After that, we'll drive through Sahinefendi and visit the Roman ruins of Sobesos, a recently excavated site featuring beautiful ground mosaics. At Soganli Valley, we'll take a 2 km walk through the valley and visit its famous cave churches, followed by a lunch break in Soganli Village. After lunch, we proceed to Kaymakli Underground City, the deepest underground city in Cappadocia, offering a fascinating glimpse into ancient life. Transfer to Kayseri airport for flight to Izmir. Arrival to Izmir, transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.
day2.optional: OPTIONAL: This morning, be one of the lucky few to greet the sunrise from a hot air balloon—an unforgettable experience and the best way to start the day.

day3.title: DAY 03: Full day Ephesus Tour
day3.content: Breakfast, 09:00am visit Ephesus Ancient City, Enter through the Magnesia Gate and begin a slow, downhill walk with your guide into the ruins of this Roman provincial capital. Your route takes you past the Odeon, the Celsus Library, the Temple of Hadrian, the Fountain of Trajan. The Grand Theatre, where Saint Paul preached, is the largest theatre is antiquity with capacity of 24,000 seats. Next visit the Temple of Artemis and the House of the Virgin Mary's. Overnight in Kusadasi.

day4.title: DAY 04: Pamukkale Tour - Flight to Istanbul
day4.content: Breakfast, 07:30am head to Pamukkale and enjoy a visit to the natural travertines (Cotton Castle) formed by lime deposits, one of the most visited of Turkey's natural wonders. Also explore the ruins of Hierapolis. Then if you like to swim in the Ancient Pool which is also called Cleopatra's Pool they charge extra entrance fee. Please note that drive to Pamukkale is around 3 hours. After tour, transfer to Denizli airport for an evening flight to Istanbul at 19:50pm. 21:10pm, Arrival to Istanbul, meet at the airport and transfer to your hotel.

day1.title: DAY 01: Flight to Kayseri - North Cappadocia Tour
day1.content: 04:00am, pick up from hotel and transfer to Istanbul airport for flight to Kayseri at 06:45am. 08:00am, Arrival & transfer to Cappadocia. Our first stop will be Uchisar, where you'll have the opportunity to take pictures of "The Castle" and explore the area around it (from the outside). Next, we'll drive to Cavusin (Rose Valley), renowned for its stunning red rock formations. Following this, we'll visit the Valley of Fairy Chimneys, Pasabagi, and Zelve Open Air Museum. After lunch visit Devrent Valley and Three Beauties Valley, which are among the most important sights of North Cappadocia. Afterward, we'll continue to the ancient towns of Urgup and Avanos, famous for their red clay pottery. Here, you'll have the chance to try your hand at pottery-making. As an optional activity, we can also visit a Turkish rug and carpet-making factory. Overnight in Cappadocia.

day2.title: DAY 02: South Cappadocia Tour - Overnight Coach to Pamukkale
day2.content: After breakfast, Pick-up from the hotel will be at 9:30-10:00 AM. The tour begins with a visit to Ortahisar, where you'll have a great photo opportunity to capture the iconic Ortahisar Rock Castle. Next, we head to Mustafapasa, a former Greek village once known as Sinasos. After that, we'll drive through Sahinefendi and visit the Roman ruins of Sobesos, a recently excavated site featuring beautiful ground mosaics. At Soganli Valley, we'll take a 2 km walk through the valley and visit its famous cave churches, followed by a lunch break in Soganli Village. After lunch, we proceed to Kaymakli Underground City, the deepest underground city in Cappadocia, offering a fascinating glimpse into ancient life. After tour, transfer to bus station for overnight coach to Pamukkale at 20:30pm. Overnight on Intercity Coach.
day2.optional: OPTIONAL: This morning, be one of the lucky few to greet the sunrise from a hot air balloon—an unforgettable experience and the best way to start the day.

day3.title: DAY 03: Pamukkale Tour - Transfer to Kusadasi
day3.content: 07:00am, Arrival to Pamukkale, meet at the bus station and transfer to your hotel for breakfast. 10:00am, Pick-up from hotel and head to Pamukkale to enjoy a visit to the natural travertines (Cotton Castle) formed by lime deposits, one of the most visited of Turkey's natural wonders. Also explore the ruins of Hierapolis. Then if you like to swim in the Ancient Pool which is also called Cleopatra's Pool they charge extra entrance fee. After tour, transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

day4.title: DAY 04: Ephesus Tour - Flight to Istanbul
day4.content: Breakfast, 09:00am visit Ephesus Ancient City, Enter through the Magnesia Gate and begin a slow, downhill walk with your guide into the ruins of this Roman provincial capital. Your route takes you past the Odeon, the Celsus Library, the Temple of Hadrian, the Fountain of Trajan. The Grand Theatre, where Saint Paul preached, is the largest theatre is antiquity with capacity of 24,000 seats. Next visit the Temple of Artemis and the House of the Virgin Mary's. After tour, transfer to Izmir airport for an evening flight to Istanbul at 19:50pm. 21:10pm, Arrival to Istanbul, meet at the airport and transfer to your hotel.
